operations.summary: List the caller's merged consumption statement (orders, recharges and balance ledger entries)
operations.description: Requires billing.account.read in the caller's own tenant scope. Merges manual order records, package and traffic-package orders, recharge orders and balance ledger postings that have no order row (manual adjustments, migration import credits, refund/void reversals, reseller sale/wholesale) into one newest-first page. Order-like rows are restricted to the caller's own user unless the caller holds billing.order_records.read; ledger rows belong to the tenant balance and follow the same visibility as GET /v1/account/ledger. Ledger operations that already have an order row (checkout debit, provider payment, recharge payment) are not repeated.
